pr_title: fix(migrations): migration failed finding tsconfig file
pr_body:
With this change we change the logic to locate the tsconfig files. The public API to locate, read and parse the workspace configuration should be use instead of the custom implemented logic.

The custom implemented logic depended on methods which have long been deprecated and are not removed in version 13 of the Angular CLI. This was not caught during development/UT because this repo is using outdated Angular Tooling packages.

This change also updates a number of spec files which previously creating an invalid Angular workspace configuration file.

Closes #43334

**NB: in a seperate PR we should update the tooling packages to version 13**
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/5472c28fa1ddc002a93803a14ed5c6c865ca4dd8/package.json#L43-L47
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/5472c28fa1ddc002a93803a14ed5c6c865ca4dd8/package.json#L66

issue_context.title: Migration failed finding tsconfig file 12 to 13
issue_context.body:
### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug?

Don't known / other

### Is this a regression?

No

### Description

When upgrading a project from 12.2.4 to 13.0.0-next.3/4, the migrator gives an error while doing:

`Migrates '[routerLink]=""' because these links are likely intented to route to the current page with updated fragment/query params.`

(aside: "intented" should be "intended" in above message)




### Please provide a link to a minimal reproduction of the bug

_No response_

### Please provide the exception or error you saw

```true
Migration failed: Could not find any tsconfig file. Cannot check templates for empty routerLinks.
```


### Please provide the environment you discovered this bug in

```true
Angular CLI: 13.0.0-next.3
Node: 14.15.0
Package Manager: npm 7.21.0
OS: Win32 x64

Angular: 13.0.0-next.4
... animations, common, compiler, compiler-cli, ore-forms
... platform-browser, platform-browser-dynamic, router
```


### Anything else?

I replicated this starting with Angular CLI 12.2.2:

`ng new bare-angular-project` choosing defaults.

cd into directory

`ng upgrade --next @angular/cli @angular/core`
